HOW I THINK

The right question
changes the solution.

I combine research, product thinking, and an eye for detail. Sometimes the biggest step forward is a small, well-chosen change.

The story behind this decision ↗

A DECISION, UNPACKED Inspector reporting tool

?

The test passed.
The real experience didn’t.

Inspectors were abandoning a reporting tool. Controlled usability tests didn’t explain why, so I moved the research into their working environment.

Diary research + on-site observation
↔

More room to interact.
Very little to rebuild.

We increased component height and spacing by 16px and added missing analytics. A focused interface adjustment took only a few hours to implement.

A change proportional to the problem
✓

A better fit for
the people doing the work.

In the following week, no new usability complaints or rage clicks were recorded, and some senior inspectors returned to the tool.

Observed after release · one week

One example of finding the simplest effective solution.

SnappMarketSenior Product Designer · DiscoveryApr 2025–Present+

Senior Product DesignerApr 2026–Present

Product DesignerApr 2025–Apr 2026

Working with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams on Discovery experiences. As a Product Designer, I refined product-based shopping and played a key role in rebuilding the core visual and interaction foundations.

  • Product-based shopping: 3× flow-level conversion and ~5% overall platform conversion uplift.
  • Core redesign: ~5% conversion improvement and ~20% faster purchase completion.
  • Store discovery for the Hyper Stores merge, Smart Bought Together, referrals, and Brand Pages.

Outcomes refer to individual initiatives; the conversion improvements are not additive.

Tapsi FoodProduct Designer · POSNov 2024–Apr 2025+

Designed a cross-platform POS used by 100+ restaurants after its first soft launch. Field research and on-site observation shaped tools that fit both small cafés and larger restaurants.

  • Unified dine-in, takeaway, phone, and online order management.
  • Menu building, table layouts, and recipe-based inventory.
  • Staff and courier management, accounting, discounts, and basic loyalty.
  • Real-time dashboards and exportable financial reports, optimized for low-end hardware.
ShabProduct DesignerNov 2023–Jul 2024+

Improved the guest-side experience at a vacation rental marketplace, contributing to product decisions as well as design.

  • Booking modal: +6% booking conversion.
  • Listing filters and cards: +8% PLP conversion.
  • Guest commenting flow: +12% submitted reviews.
  • My Trips and invoice pages: +8% guest payment rate.

Further work covered the calendar, checkout, property details, and trip flows.
